raw_response:
This small plot is my enset and a few coffee bushes mixed with some banana — I do not put the chemical fertilizer on it, I never have and my father never did. I throw the household ash and the manure from my goats around the enset, and the cooking water goes there too. The plants I already have from suckers I took from my uncle's plot, so no need to buy seed. I weed it myself when I am home, my wife helps with mulching — we do not pay anyone for such a small piece near the house.
